references.text: The anointed priest who succeeds his father in the office shall perform this service. This is a permanent statute.
The anointing of priests establishes a perpetual priesthood through the generations.
The priest shall take a handful of the flour and oil, along with all the incense, and burn it as a memorial offering on the altar.
The anointed priest (הַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ) is mentioned in connection with the sin offering.
A permanent statute (חָק־עוֹלָם) for all generations concerning offerings to the Lord.
The priest's grain offering shall be burned completely (כָּלִיל) and not eaten.
The offering shall be burned completely as a pleasing aroma to the Lord, a permanent statute.
Christ as high priest does not need, like the Levitical priests, to offer daily sacrifices.
